titulo: Blade Runner 2099’s moody dystopia streams on Amazon in November
cuerpo: After teasing the series with some first-look images yesterday, Amazon is finally properly unveiling its Blade Runner streaming series. Called Blade Runner 2099, the show hits Prime Video on November 25th with all eight episodes dropping at once.
